name: Neon Wireframe
prompt: The whole scene turns dark and the person becomes glowing Tron-style neon outlines, bright cyan and magenta light tracing the edges of the body, clothes and surroundings, thin luminous wireframe lines on a near-black background, soft bloom, cinematic sci-fi, the person keeps their pose and motion, the camera and framing match the original footage
negative_prompt: blurry, low quality, distorted face, extra limbs, warped body, flickering, watermark, text, subtitles, cartoon, deformed hands
